paragraphs.text:
A gasp warns you that Norman has been hit—crushed beneath 
a twenty-pound rock. Sylvia turns back to help him. You cry 
out, urging her to keep going, but it is not in Sylvia’s nature to 
abandon a companion.

You can only watch as a fragment of basalt, hurled from the 
cliff, strikes Sylvia’s head. Her skull bursts like a melon.
